nodes.label: Custom Command Configuration (design rationale)
nodes.rationale: Custom, user-editable commands let the app support different Bluetooth device/firmware protocols (not all RC car receivers use the same command characters), give users control to adapt the app to their specific hardware, and are persisted via AsyncStorage so configuration survives restarts. Documented benefits: flexibility, user control, ease of use, persistence, and safety (reset/validation).

nodes.label: Bluetooth Permission (rationale)
nodes.rationale: Bluetooth permission is requested solely to discover, connect, and communicate with nearby Bluetooth-enabled devices such as the Bluetooth-controlled car; the app does not collect, store, or share any personal information via this permission.

nodes.label: Location Permission (rationale)
nodes.rationale: Location permission is requested only because the Android OS requires it to perform Bluetooth device scans; the app does not access, collect, track, or store any location data despite holding this permission.
